references.text: The same curse: a sky like bronze and earth like iron as punishment for disobedience to God's covenant
Elijah prophesies drought over Israel as fulfillment of the curse about a closed sky
Describes the severe drought that struck the land; the sky gave no rain
Jeremiah describes drought as God's judgment on the people; the earth is cracked because no rain came
Amos describes how God withheld rain as punishment, fulfilling the covenant curse
Haggai explains that the sky withheld dew and the earth its produce due to the people's disobedience
God struck the harvest with drought and blight, but the people did not turn back
The two witnesses have power to shut the sky so it does not rain, an eschatological parallel to the curse
